comments.text:
“Advanced” voice mode is probably the biggest load of BS that came from OpenAI.  Aside from a couple of cute party tricks and that you can interrupt it by talking, it is actually less advanced than the default voice mode, which can access memory, use the web, and can read from the personalization profile in settings where you can give it a personality and command that it speaks in a certain way and tone, rather than the overly caffeinated, obsequious corporate demeanor in advanced mode.  My standard voice mode now talks WAY more naturally thanks to this.

Aaaand… the demo from MONTHS ago was COMPLETELY misleading and yet no one talks about it!  lol  It boasted totally natural interaction, ability to see through your camera, a more elegant talk to interrupt feature, ability to detect user emotions through voice inflections, ability to hum tunes, and faster, natural response times.  I actually hate the talk to interrupt because it is primitive and any sound or movement of the phone in certain way will interrupt it, so tap to interrupt is currently still more practical.
